_note: Operator directive 2026-10-21 (23:41 CEST): launch a long ten-hour research batch, Orchestrator chooses the subject, at most four Scientists, and an hourly watch for ten hours that restarts any Scientist stopped by a token rate limit or by a finished lot — continuing or moving to new studies. Standing authorisations (procedi sempre; push is the backup) and the section 21d reserved list bind. Identity orchestrator is a stated assumption.
OBJECTIVE: Ten-hour research batch on the drug-repurposing line for WOREE / WWOX-DEE: advance roadmap P3 (scientific qualification) to the point where P4 candidate cards can be produced for both paths, with up to four Scientists on adjacent and transferable literature, then produce the first cards from the repository's own qualified records.

SUBJECT_DECISION.chosen: Repurposing P3/P4, four groups: R1 Q230P-class missense proteostasis (qualify the premise of three recovered historic dossiers); R2 T-type calcium-channel axis and genotype-specific antiseizure pharmacology (DL-MECH-170); R3 downstream pathways with neurological evidence (Wnt/MYC/GSK3/mTOR, neuroinflammation-myelin pharmacology, paediatric safety class); R4 repurposing precedents and design in other monogenic DEEs (endpoints, symptomatic-versus-modifying separation, N-of-1 and external controls)
SUBJECT_DECISION.why: the WWOX-direct lawful-body pool is exhausted (previous batches); P3 is half done and P4 has produced no card; the reconciliation showed the infrastructure is ready and the science is the limit; the four groups map to the roadmap's open questions rather than to a keyword
SUBJECT_DECISION.alternatives_rejected: a fifth fresh WWOX-literature sweep (selector found fewer than 12 selectable studies last time); installing the external components (nothing needs them yet and there is no R interpreter)

RATE LIMIT: session limit hit at about 02:00Z, reset 02:40Z; stopped: scientist-b (GSE156243), scientist-c (R3c), Harness (bridge gaps). The hourly watch could not run in that window because the REPL was busy; at 03:16Z no agent was live. Resumed all three from durable state; scientist-a and scientist-d had finished their lots and were handed P5 and the WWOX-rows sweep. Lesson: the watch fires only when idle, so a limit that stops everything is noticed only when the next prompt arrives
